title: Fantastic private guided tour - thoroughly recommend, especially Rabie our guide.
text: Private night tour of the Alhambra. Rabie was lovely; knowledgeable and helpful. We learned lots and really enjoyed the beautiful location and translations.
author: Kate_T

title: Excellent information
text: Excellent guide very polite and informative with plenty of knowledge about the visited location and their history , no queues or line to wait for.
author: Sami_G

title: Best guide ever
text: Best guide ever! Explains everything about alhambra .
author: Pioneer55591852246

title: Great Guide
text: Maria was a great guide.  She had in-depth knowledge about the Alhambra and its history.  She was able to tailor the tour to my interests and adapt to my questions on the fly.  I would thoroughly recommend her and this tour to others.
author: ElizabethM_R

title: Magical
text: Alhambra is so beautiful and magical that you cannot miss it if you visit Granada; by visiting it and experiencing it, you understand why it is known as the eighth wonder of the world. We were lucky to have Rosa as our guide; we loved the experience.
author: Judith_B

title: Rosa is the best!
text:
Our tour guide, Rosa, was simple fantastic. She was communicative - pre meeting us for the tour, about meeting spot and timeliness. She followed up. We felt taken care of. 
During the tour of the Alhambra, she was knowledgeable, patient with our questions and super informative. Took AMAZING pictures of us, was patient with my mother who walks slower due to mild mobility issues. 
She knew the best spots for pictures, gave us amazing tidbits of historical facts and was simply a kind and courteous tour guide. Recommend her 100%.
author: Vivian_T

title: Great experience. Thank you, Rosa.
text: Incredible visit and specialized guide. Thank you, Rosa! For the patience, support, and above all, the energy of this trip.
author: Victor_C

title: This was a very thorough...
text: This was a very thorough tour! We felt like we experienced everything about the Alhambra. We learned a lot of historical facts, took amazing photos, and had a lovely time. The pace was nicely spaced to give enough time to see everything without getting boring.
author: Brianne_H

title: La Alambrada is a dream come true!
text:
Our trip to La Alambrada was wonderful! One of the most beautiful places in the world! 
Eduardo, our guide, is a person with exceptional knowledge and a great historian; we enjoyed every moment of our trip through La Alhambra, fully immersing ourselves in its history and beauty thanks to our guide Eduardo! This trip through La Alambrada has been unforgettable and magical!
author: Iris_G

title: Last minute booking turned to magic.
text: Amazing places. The guide (ربيع) knows all the information which he tells them as a story so you wont be board. It was worth it knowing all the short cuts. The cherry on the top was that he speaks 5 languages including Arabic which made it magical reading all those engravings on the walls. Definitely worth it.
author: Fatemah A
